edges.instruction: Follow the long corridor towards the Cafeteria. The Gallery Area opens off it on the way.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the long corridor back towards Reception 2.

edges.instruction: Take the narrow passage between the studios and the amphitheatre.
edges.instructionRev: Come down the passage to the main corridor.

edges.instruction: Follow the bent wing, keeping the Maker's Hives beside you.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the bent wing back down towards the studios.

edges.instruction: Walk along the top of the amphitheatre.
edges.instructionRev: Walk back along the top of the amphitheatre.

edges.instruction: Go down the steps into the amphitheatre.
edges.instructionRev: Climb the steps out of the amphitheatre.

edges.instruction: Go up through the gap between the Teacher's Cubicle and Reception 2.
edges.instructionRev: Come back down past Reception 2 to the corridor.

edges.instruction: Go through the Library Entrance, beside the Teacher's Cubicle.
edges.instructionRev: Leave the library through the Library Entrance.

edges.instruction: Go out of the Infirmary into the corridor.
edges.instructionRev: The Infirmary is at the very end of the corridor.

edges.instruction: Go through the double doors into the reception corridor.
edges.instructionRev: Go through the double doors and carry on along the corridor, past the rooms.

edges.instruction: Go through the double doors into Reception.
edges.instructionRev: Leave Reception through the double doors into the corridor.

edges.instruction: Go out through the door onto the football field.
edges.instructionRev: Go in through the door into the reception corridor.

edges.instruction: Go out through the main entrance, beside the lift.
edges.instructionRev: Come in through the main entrance into Reception.

edges.instruction: Go through into the hall.
edges.instructionRev: Go through into Reception.

edges.instruction: Walk along the front of the building.
edges.instructionRev: Walk along the front of the building to the main entrance.

edges.instruction: Go down to the Main Gate.
edges.instructionRev: Come in through the Main Gate and walk up to the building.

edges.instruction: Go through the Atelier doors nearest Reception.
edges.instructionRev: Leave the Atelier through the doors into the hall.

edges.instruction: Go through the Atelier doors just past the stairs.
edges.instructionRev: Leave the Atelier through the doors into the hall.

edges.instruction: Follow the classrooms along the straight wall.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the corridor back to the Atelier doors.

edges.instruction: Follow the rooms along the angled wall.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the corridor back to the Atelier doors.

edges.instruction: Go round the top of the courtyard.
edges.instructionRev: Follow the classrooms down the straight wall.

edges.instruction: Follow the rooms down the angled wall.
edges.instructionRev: Go round the top of the courtyard.

edges.instruction: Climb the Cafeteria Stairs to the first floor. You come out in the Gallery Area.
edges.instructionRev: Take the Cafeteria Stairs down to the ground floor. You come out in the reception corridor.

edges.instruction: Climb the First Floor Stairs. You come out in front of the Cafeteria.
edges.instructionRev: Take the stairs down to the ground floor. You come out in the hall past Reception.

edges.instruction: Take the lift up to the first floor. You come out in the corridor by Reception 2.
edges.instructionRev: Take the lift down to the ground floor. You come out in Reception.
